'''Montrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Dagorel found out that Frangee was sent here by an ex-business partner of mine. I need you to make sure he retires. Permanently.|Borvo the Hutt, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BA" />}}
[[File:ImpVsGunganMonument.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Gungan monument where Montrus was hidding before his death.]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Montrus was a business partner of [[Borvo]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. However, they eventually stopped working together.<ref name="SWG:BA" /> Circa [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he introduced [[Niksel Frangee]] to the Hutt and Frangee subsequently joined Borvo's organization.<ref name="SWG:BA" /> Frangee was in fact an infiltrated agent of the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:BGATTC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Guard - A Trip To Corellia|Naboo}}</ref>

Six years later,<ref name="SWG:BC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bluffing CorSec|Corellia}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Niksel Frangee was identified as a CorSec detective and assassinated by Borvo's henchmen.<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Guard|Naboo}}</ref>. Borvo suspected that Montrus was aware of Frangee's true identity and hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to assassinate him. The spacer tracked down Montrus to a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] monument in the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]], near the site of an [[Imperial vs. Gungan Battle]], and killed him.<ref name="SWG:BA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Every possible depiction of Montrus]]
Montrus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Montrus spawned under the generic "borvo_montrus" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. However, the scenario clearly identified him as male.<ref name="SWG:BA" />

Borvo's ex-business partner was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline (pre-NGE)|Borvo the Hutt's questline]].<ref name="SWG:BtH">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Borvo The Hutt|Naboo}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Borvo the Hutt's questline was [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline|revamped]]. While the gameplay of the questline was extensively upgraded, the storyline remained similar. Borvo's ex-business partner was given the name Montrus in the updated questline.<ref name="SWG:BA" />
